annotations.title: How to do one exercise, the muscles it works and a picture

description: Plan My Workout. How to do one exercise, the muscles it works and a picture. For requests like "how do I do a Romanian deadlift?", "what is a goblet squat?", "what muscles do face pulls work?". Understands everyday names like RDL, press-up and lat pulldown. muscles.main lists the muscles the move mainly works (hand-checked for the main lifts) and muscles.also the ones that help.
